messages:
claire: Quick follow-up from infra Q&A re: GPU supply and autoscaler behavior. Posting short questions here.

jon: Is the APAC bias temporary or will it be an ongoing traffic steering policy?

eng-infra: Temporary bias for ~60 days while shipments arrive. We'll revert once buffer >15%.

jon: If bias causes cross-region routing, how will product teams see that in metrics?

eng-infra: We tag requests with region_requested, region_served, fallback_reason. Dashboards will show p50/p95 split by these tags.

claire: Can customers opt-out of cross-region fallback without a ticket?

eng-infra: Hosted defaults allow cross-region fallback. Region-lock requires a support ticket; Dedicated/Private can set policy.

sre-bot: event: infra-autoscale-1901234599 triggered  22 requests moved from apac to us-west-2.

jon: Are warm pool sizes changing during the bias window?

eng-infra: No changes to defaults (critical=4, standard=2) unless tenant requests higher reservoir or we flip to reservation mode.

claire: Thanks — please post the short status blurb to infra-status and tag product for the dashboard update.

eng-infra: Will do by EOD.
